title: pm: the queue guard's Tier S record leg reads the verdict and the record's author
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTdPXH4QHzz9PENrUk8uety)_

Fixes #33541

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5n5ZXLzdMDs4q4mC6r

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**: 合并队列守卫的 Tier S 复核记录腿现在读结论和作者：同 head 记录只有恰好一行 `VERDICT:` 且为 PASS 才放行（FAIL、没有、两行都拒，拒词点名评论 id，同 head 多条取最新）；只认 fleet 中继机器人和 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` 贴的评论，其他人贴的一律不读。
- **为什么改**: 之前 FAIL 记录也能放行 `.claude/**`，比 AGENTS.md 第 14 条「PASS 结论」宽；公开仓上任何人都能贴一条格式对的记录让守卫放行（评审 D 项）。
- **风险与回滚**: 整体是收紧：FAIL 记录不再放行，只有 heading 内联或裸 PASS、没有 `VERDICT:` 行的旧式记录现在被拒。唯一会放行的方向是作者绑定：不受信作者的评论一律不读，席位误用个人账号贴的记录也一样，所以一条这样的较新 FAIL 不会遮住较早的中继 PASS，那条 PASS 照样放行，这是裁定的行为（席位记录都走中继，按机器人落地）。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**: `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` 的 `recordPassVerdict`、`recordAuthorTrusted` 和 `runGuard` 里读线程那几行；`check-half-states.mjs` 新增的 `contractReviewVerdictLines`。
- **两分钟验证**: `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`，预期 506 例全过。
- **需要你做的**: 无，席位落地。

## What changes

1. **The verdict, on every Tier S leg** (`scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`). New `recordPassVerdict(record, pair, recognisers)` runs on every Tier S entry the record leg reads, not only the low-risk skills arm. A record that stands clears only when the comment the locator chose carries exactly ONE `VERDICT:` line under its heading and that line reads PASS. FAIL, no `VERDICT:` line (a heading-inline or bare word alone included), and two lines (a quoted earlier verdict, a FAIL appended under a PASS) each refuse as `not-pass`, and the refusal names the comment id. Several same-head records: the locator's newest one is read, so a later FAIL withdraws an earlier PASS and a later PASS supersedes an earlier FAIL. `lowRiskRecordVerdict` keeps its carry rule and then calls the same function. The words now say the record reads PASS on every leg, and the third remedy names the `**VERDICT: PASS**` line and the author rule.
2. **One reader, counting form** (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`). `contractReviewVerdictLines(body)` sits beside `contractReviewVerdictOf` and uses the same explicit-line regex constant, so it is the fleet's one verdict reader with a second answer, never a second parser. The patrol reader keeps its first-match answer. `record-recognisers.mjs` re-exports the counting form in place of `contractReviewVerdictOf`, which only the guard's loader read.
3. **The author** (item D of `pm-orders/review/33531-delegation-review.md`, card comment 6887864752). `recordAuthorTrusted(row, trusted)`: a comment is read only when its `user.login` is the relay's identity or an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`. The relay login is `FLEET_BOT_LOGIN`, declared once in `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` and loaded lazily with the recognisers (`RECOGNISER_SOURCES.author`). No login is typed into the guard. The relay keeps no sender list of its own (`fleet-write.yml` gates a stroke on the sender's write permission), so those two declarations are the whole set the repository names. `runGuard` drops every other row right after each thread is fetched, before the locator reads it, so an untrusted comment can neither be the record, nor shadow a trusted one, nor name a `Regen-provenance:` hop. It is ignored, never refused loudly: an absent-record refusal adds one information line naming the ignored authors. An unreadable author is untrusted. A loader that cannot read `FLEET_BOT_LOGIN` is unavailable (exit 4), never trust-everyone.
   - **Narrower than the card comment, on the seat's word:** comment 6887864752 said "the fleet relay bot or an organisation member". The order and the seat (2026-11-15T06:09Z) ruled the declared set instead: the relay plus `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`. A record a seat posts directly from its own account (for example `os-project-manager`) is ignored; seat records go through the relay and arrive as the bot.
   - **Why the import is lazy:** a module-scope import of `check-handover.mjs` from `record-recognisers.mjs` was measured to break `check-owed-reviews.mjs` (`ReferenceError: Cannot access 'ROSTER_MARKER' before initialization` in `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, a cycle through `post-stamped.mjs`). The guard already loads the recognisers lazily, so the relay identity rides the same loader.
4. **Docblocks.** The guard header, `recordPassVerdict`, `locateReviewOfRecord` (the locator itself still reads no verdict and no author; both are the guard's facts, so its other caller `check-owed-reviews.mjs` keeps its reading) and the patrol reader's docblock now say who reads what.

**Widened file surface:** the claim named the guard and `record-recognisers.mjs`. The seat widened it to `check-half-states.mjs` for the counting reader (seat thread, 2026-11-15T06:09Z: option A, "a single reader"). No other in-flight card touches it.

`skip-changeset`: `scripts/pm/**` only, published by no package.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`: **506 cases pass** (488 on `main`; 18 new, 4 flipped). Every fixture comment is now posted by the relay login the live loader assembles, never a typed login.
  - ⛔ **flipped:** a same-head FAIL record on a `.claude/**` PR is now REFUSED (exit 3), naming comment 900 and Prime Directive 14 (was: "a FAIL record still stands as a RECORD"); the non-arm FAIL row likewise (was: "the other Tier S legs are unchanged, follow-up #33541"); the passing words say "READS PASS" and who posted it (was: "EXISTENCE and PROVENANCE, never the verdict"); the source pin counts two loader sources.
  - ⛔ new, verdict: no `VERDICT:` line (bare `PASS` alone) refused; two lines (PASS then quoted FAIL) refused, naming "states 2 `VERDICT:` lines (PASS, FAIL)"; even two PASS lines refused; FAIL after PASS refused with the newer id; ⭐ PASS after FAIL across the two threads clears with the newer id; ⭐ a heading-inline PASS beside one `VERDICT:` line clears (inline is not a second line).
  - ⛔ new, author: a record posted directly by `os-project-manager` is ignored, so the entry reads no record and is refused, and the words name the author as information, not as a refusal; a drive-by commenter's perfect PASS record clears nothing; an unreadable author is ignored; an untrusted newer FAIL does not shadow a trusted PASS, and an untrusted newer PASS does not lift a trusted FAIL; ⭐ a record posted by an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` is read; `recordAuthorTrusted` is exact and fails closed on no list; a loader that cannot read `FLEET_BOT_LOGIN` is unavailable; a recogniser set with no trusted list reads no author; a `Regen-provenance:` hop posted by an untrusted author carries nothing; the live loader trusts the relay first, then `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, and nothing else.
- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test`: **388 cases pass** (386 before). The #18701 cross-tool pin now posts the `--template` record through the relay login, and two new pins (floor 17 → 19) say: the template record carries exactly one `VERDICT:` line reading PASS and the guard that cleared it read that verdict; the same record posted by an untrusted author is refused as no record.
- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: **5257 cases pass**; one new H43 row pins `contractReviewVerdictLines` (one line, two lines with a quoted one counted, none for the inline and bare dialects, none without a heading).
- `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test`: 84 cases pass (the locator's other caller, unchanged).

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` spells its own `VERDICT_LINE` regex for a display column (`verdictOf`, "a display, never a judgment") and reads no author. It decides nothing, so it is left as it is; carrier: none.
- The register reads `scripts/pm/**` as NOT governed (`check-governed-merges.mjs --branch`, below), while the card body calls this change Tier S. The landing route is the seat's to read.

## Verification

All local runs on head `3f5a0824`, exit codes captured before any pipe; the full record is the project file `pm-orders/skills/33541-gates-ran.txt`.

<details><summary>Derived gate list — 49 of 49 run, all exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 49 commands for the 3 paths. Every one ran and exited 0, among them `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` (506 cases), `pnpm check:pm-record-recognisers` (388), `pnpm check:pm-half-states` (5257), `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `pnpm check:pm-post-stamped`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:commit-card-trailers` and `pnpm check:scripts-symbol-anchors`. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "49 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 49 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The families the derivation names as CI-only or workflow-valued (for example `check-half-states.mjs --format=markdown`) are CI's.

</details>

<details><summary>Tier, governed register, size</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --tier`: "Model tier — no path-derived mandate: the surface hits none of the 4 declared glob(s)". The tier is the seat's per-card call.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/project-thread-qy6xre`: "0 of 3 path(s) hit the register … NOT governed — ordinary queue landing applies". Head repo NOT MEASURED there (`--pr` reads it).
- Size: 271 changed lines (+214 / -57), under the 3000-line human-merge threshold.

</details>

<details><summary>Import-cycle probe</summary>

Each importer of the touched files was loaded with `--help` after the change: the guard, `record-recognisers.mjs`, `check-half-states.mjs`, `check-handover.mjs` and `check-owed-reviews.mjs` all load. The first draft imported `check-handover.mjs` at module scope from `record-recognisers.mjs`; `check-owed-reviews.mjs --help` then failed with a TDZ ReferenceError (it loads on `main`), which is why the relay identity is loaded lazily by the guard instead.

</details>
